tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a workflow in data/workflows.json by registering the whole task DAG (AI and human tasks with dependencies) in one call.

tasks.description: All tasks of the workflow. Reference other tasks in this call by their temporary 'key'.

key.description: Temporary key used only inside this call to reference dependencies. Example: t1

description.description: Optional details about what to do.

assignee.description: Who performs the task: the agent (ai) or the user (human).

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks that must finish first.

tools.name: add_workflow_task
tools.description: Add one task to an existing workflow. depends_on must use real task ids from that workflow.

workflow_id.description: Target workflow id. Defaults to the only active workflow.

description.description: Optional details about what to do.

depends_on.description: Existing task ids that must finish first.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Record a task's status transition (pending/running/done/failed/skipped) and an optional result summary.

workflow_id.description: Workflow id. Optional; the task is searched across workflows when omitted.

result.description: Short outcome summary recorded with done/failed.

tools.name: show_workflow
tools.description: Show one workflow with all tasks, dependencies, and which tasks are READY to start.

workflow_id.description: Workflow id. Defaults to the only active workflow.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows with progress (done/total tasks and ready count). Can filter by status.

status.description: Filter status: active, done, or all.

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Delete a workflow and all of its tasks by workflow id.

tools.name: open_workflow_viewer
tools.description: Start the local workflow viewer (http://127.0.0.1:8765/) if needed and open it in the browser.

port.description: Viewer port. Defaults to LITTLE_AGENT_VIEWER_PORT or 8765.

workflow_id.description: Open the viewer focused on this workflow.
